author: Legoche
body:
I want my infractions list cleared if possible :)


Watch The Language!

Well I was warned for swearing. At the time I didn't know this was against the rules, as the rules for swearing have been tossed back and forth. Also, I only said one word, when I died all I said was "fuck".

Combat Logging

Well, there was no hard evidence for this one, but basically, I had to go and I left the game whilst in the void. I didn't combat log because I was about to die, but I logged out in the void because I had the glitch when you can't press any buttons on the re-spawn screen.

Thats about it, I hope these get appealed :)

title: Appealing My 2 Infractions.

replies.author: PublixEmployee
replies.body:
Hello Legoche,

I will talk about the infraction I gave you for swearing, as it was my infraction, but I'm going to leave the one for combat logging to be talk about.

At the time of when you did say it, it was against the rules and it was only a warn as it /was/ still against the rules and the warn was to just make sure you do NOT do it again in the future. Remember too, we also can't appeal someone just because they do /NOT/ know the rules, as we would have to go back and probably appeal too many people. including many hackers who did /not/ know. It is your job to know the rules, and if you broke a rule and didn't know that is your problem, not the staff.
Even though I did say all that, I'm going to appeal the warn as it is no longer against the rules and the warn is so old.
 

 Have a good day,
 DoctaPop.
